result:
**Verdict: PASS.** I'm raising no new findings, so there is no findings sidecar.

The candidate checked out cleanly. Its ID, `sha256:8376d762…fc455` (757 files, source `171a0b57`), recomputed the same at the start, in the clone, and against HEAD at the end. HEAD moved during the run only because other reviewers' evidence was committed, all under `docs/delivery/`. I read no other reviewer's round-4 record.

**The round-4 formula repair (T-DG3-KBE-F), tested from the acceptance side:**
- **`value.ts` is now covered by the formula lint rules.** I added 12 forbidden forms to it in a throwaway copy, and lint refused every one (22 errors).
- **An attempted code generation is no longer hidden.** I injected one at run time into each of the engine's three catch blocks in turn. Each time the no-code-generation test run failed with EvalError (73, 24 and 3 failures), instead of turning it into an "internal" formula problem as in round 3. The normal test run still passes, as the architecture decision (ADR-0024) intends.
- **The API still answers 422 for invalid formulas.** I sent 13 invalid or hostile expressions. Twelve got 422 with their own error code, and the empty string got 400 from the request schema. None got 500 or the internal fallback. Creating a formula with a syntax error gives 422, and a valid formula still gives 200.
- **Invalid stored values still show as Unknown.** `formatDecimal` returns null for them, in English and Arabic.
- **The formula examples are unchanged:** 3.30 shows as 57.5; 100000 SAR (twice); 151852.11; the period mismatch and the undefined variable are refused.

**Full regression:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static (typecheck, build, lint, OpenAPI with 270 operations, no-CDN, format, contrast) | all exit 0 |
| Unit tests: Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | both test runs in all 4 settings: 1593 tests, then 199 passed and 1 skipped of 200 |
| Integration on a throwaway PostgreSQL, twice | 793/793 each; 27 migrations; every pending-operations list empty |
| e2e, both languages, both locale settings | per setting: 216 passed, 2 failed (exit 1); product and A20 specs 182/182, the same as round 3 spec by spec |
| My literal acceptance checks for all 32 requirements | 166 per project per setting (163 from round 3 plus 3 new formula checks), 0 failed |
| Accessibility (axe) | 1392 page analyses with 0 violations; my 32 axe checks pass |
| Read-only auditor | sent only reads; every write attempt got 403 |
| Validators (register, pipeline, historical DG2 and DG1) | all PASS, at the start and at the end |

**F-DG3-180 still holds:** the inherited-approval badge stays inside its card in both languages and locale settings.

**Every non-zero exit, explained:**
- **The 2 e2e failures** are my extended layout probe, once per language. Its single assertion fails on 7 of 77 rows, all at a 390 px viewport with 200% text. The badge stays inside its card, but the page scrolls sideways. The cause is the gate grid's minimum card width, unchanged since DG2, not the badge. This matches round 3 and is below the 320 px width that WCAG requires layouts to fit, so I'm recording it as an observation, not a finding.
- **The lint probe and the three code-generation probes** exit non-zero by design; that is the expected result.
- **The 1 skipped unit test** checks the lint configuration. It can't run with code generation disabled because ESLint itself needs it, and it runs and passes in the first test run.

**Not BLOCKED, but not tested live:** the live package registry, live CI and Keycloak. Each passed on the offline or configuration side only.

I removed the two throwaway clones and my scratch files. Some leftover integration-test temp folders remain in my private temp directory, which the runner deletes when the run ends.

All test data is synthetic. Product gates G1–G6 are business approvals inside the product, and none of them implies an engineering gate DG0–DG7.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- `reviews/DG3/round-4/qa-verifier.json` (the record)
- `reviews/DG3/round-4/qa-verifier.md` (the narrative)
- `test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-4/` (logs, results and RUN-NOTES.md)
- `test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-4/e2e/dg3-qa-r4.spec.ts` (my spec)
